  https://depot.javispedro.com/vbox/vbados/releases/vbados_0_67.zip
Complete corresponding source (tag v0.67), next to the binaries:
  vbados-0.67.tar.gz  (https://git.javispedro.com/cgit/vbados.git/snapshot/vbados-0.67.tar.gz)
Licence: COPYING (GNU GPL version 2; "or (at your option) any later version").

Universal Service OS copies VBMOUSE.EXE and VBMOUSE.DRV to MS-DOS / Windows 3.x
disks that its installer prepares on a UEFI PC without a firmware CSM (through
CSMWrap), where USB mice reach DOS only through the BIOS (SeaBIOS INT 15h C2).
The stick carries the source as EFI\USOS\dos-native\msdos\VBADOS.TGZ.
